svg.text: Every step with its tools, APIs and parameters · Streamlit (app.py) · Qwen qwen3.8-27b on Groq · Apify Website Content Crawler · Gmail SMTP/IMAP
A · Find openings — company website → ranked openings + contact emails
“Draft email for this opening” → pre-fills the target and starts the agent automatically
B · Write email — agentic RAG over your resume
keep only a valid email address
else first email found on page
every sent email is tracked for replies, bounces and follow-ups
C · Sent & follow-ups — reply tracking and threaded follow-ups
only mail since the send date
Purple steps call llm.py · search_knowledge_base reads rag.py · orange steps use apify.py or mailer.py · all settings come from .env
Nothing is sent without your explicit review and click.
